title: Analysis tests: cover analyze, stems, loudness and cli; stop writing to tracked files; do not skip silently
description:
`analysis/tests` is 414 lines against about 1,780 lines of source. `analyze.py` (262 lines), `stems.py`, `loudness.py` and `cli.py` have no tests. `test_markup.py:34` and `test_manifests.py:16` skip silently when samples are absent, so a clean checkout passes without testing much. `test_server.py:34-39` rewrites a tracked manifest under `samples/citizen-dj/` in place and restores it afterwards; an interrupted run leaves the repo dirty. `test_server.py:56-66` creates and deletes `scores/` in the repo root. Long functions: `markup.sections` (93, 88 lines), `curation.terminal_feed` (505), `curation.main` (574), `analyze.tonal` (111).

Done when: tests use `tmp_path` copies of fixtures, never tracked files; sample-dependent tests use a small committed fixture or a generated signal instead of skipping; analyze, stems (mocked Demucs), loudness and cli have tests; the four long functions are split.
